title: Fireplace Sound loop
author: PagDev
transformations: Recorded wood-burning fireplace; cropped seconds 2–19, one-second equal-power crossfade yields 16-second seamless loop; downmixed mono, PCM16 44.1 kHz, peak normalized to −3.35 dBFS.
